title: Have Mercy on Me, O God

request.style: English, Gregorian chant, penitential psalm sung by a low male schola in unison, slow and hushed, no instruments, Phrygian mode, dark candlelit chapel, contrite, 54 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Have mercy on me, O God
According to your steadfast love

[Verse]
In your great compassion
Blot out my transgressions

[Verse]
Wash me thoroughly from my guilt
And cleanse me from my sin

[Outro]
Have mercy on me, O God
